evals.prompt: What namespaces exist in our main monitoring account?
evals.expected_output: Agent reads geneva-monitoring-config.md, identifies the main monitoring account, and calls metrics_get_namespaces against it via the configured MCP server.
assertions: Agent reads a *geneva-monitoring-config.md file before calling any Geneva tool
Agent uses the account name from the config, not a guessed value
Agent calls metrics_get_namespaces (not metrics_get_metric_names or a Kusto query)

evals.prompt: Read the time series for metric foo.bar in namespace baz over the last hour, sliced by env.
evals.expected_output: Agent first calls metrics_get_metric_config to confirm 'env' is in a pre-aggregation, then calls metrics_read_multi_time_series with endTimeUtc set at least 2 minutes before now.
assertions: Agent calls metrics_get_metric_config before the time-series read
endTimeUtc is at least 2 minutes earlier than the current time
If env is NOT in any pre-aggregation, agent surfaces this and does not silently return InvalidSeries
Agent uses the account from the config rather than guessing

evals.expected_output: Agent gets the V2 monitor config (or its config history if lastModifiedTime is recent), runs monitor_v2_preview_combination to discover combinations, then monitor_v2_preview_result with Monitor.Tenant included in the combination.
assertions: Agent calls monitor_get_monitor_v2_configuration or kusto_get_monitor_v2_config_history
If lastModifiedTime is recent, agent uses kusto_get_monitor_v2_config_history for the historical config
Preview combination includes Monitor.Tenant alongside the targetDimensions
startTime / endTime epochs match the requested year (no off-by-year errors)

evals.prompt: Why did the V1 monitor 'HighErrorRate' on namespace baz / metric foo.bar fire yesterday?
evals.expected_output: Agent recognizes V1 has no preview API. It addresses the monitor by (namespace, metric, monitorName) — not a GUID — gets the active config at firing time via kusto_get_monitor_v1_config_history, fetches the evaluated metric via monitor_get_v1_monitor_metrics (or reads the underlying series via metrics_read_multi_time_series), and compares against the threshold manually.
assertions: Agent does NOT call monitor_v2_preview_combination or monitor_v2_preview_result (there is no V1 preview API)
Agent addresses the monitor by (namespace, metric, monitorName), never by a GUID
Agent retrieves the config via kusto_get_monitor_v1_config_history or monitor_get_monitor_v1_configuration
Agent fetches evaluation data via monitor_get_v1_monitor_metrics or metrics_read_multi_time_series and compares it to the threshold itself
Any time-series read uses endTimeUtc at least 2 minutes before now

evals.prompt: Run a Kusto query against our logs table to count errors in the last hour.
evals.expected_output: Agent does NOT use this skill — Kusto log queries are out of scope. Agent invokes the `kusto` skill instead.
assertions: Agent does not read geneva-monitoring-config.md
Agent does not call any Geneva metrics_* or monitor_* tool
Agent does not invoke this skill
Agent suggests / invokes the `kusto` skill
